faq.heading: Imibuzo Ebuzwa Ng frequently
faq.description: Konke okufuneka ukwazi malunga neMundo Tango

q1.question: Yintoni iMundo Tango?
q1.answer: IMundo Tango yiplatifomu yehlabathi exhumanisa abadansi be-tango, othisha, kunye nabahleli. Sikusiza ukufumana imicimbi, ukufumana abalingani bokudansa, ukufunda kubafundisi abaphezulu, kwaye uzive ungaphakathi koluntu olukhanyayo lwe-tango emhlabeni jikelele.

q2.question: Is Mundo Tango simahla ukuyisebenzisa?
q2.answer: Ewe! Sinika umgangatho simahla oquka ukudalwa kweprofayili eyisiseko, ukufumanisa imicimbi, kunye nemiyalezo. Iimpawu eziphezulu ezifana nemiyalezo engapheliyo, ukufanisa umphosa we-AI, kunye nezaziso zemicimbi eziphambili zikhona kwi-subscription yethu yePro.

q3.question: Ndingenza njani ukufumana imicimbi ye-tango edlalwa kufuphi nam?
q3.answer: Sebenzisa nje iKalenda yeMicimbi yethu okanye iZixhobo zokuFuna ukuze uhlalutye ngedolophu, umhla, kunye nohlobo lomcimbi. Ungafumanisa iimilonga, iifestivali, iiworkshop, kunye neziqhelanisi ezisebenza kwi ndawo yakho okanye naphi na emhlabeni.

q4.question: Ngaba ndingaxhumana nabanye abadlali?
q4.answer: Ngokuqinisekileyo! Landela abadlali, joyina amaqela, thumela izicelo zobuhlobo, kwaye uthethe nomphakathi. Iplatifomu yethu yenzelwe ukunceda ukwakha ubudlelwane bokwenene ngaphakathi kwihlabathi le-tango.

q5.question: Ndingenza njani ukufumana ootitshala be-tango?
q5.answer: Vakashela kwiSikhumbuzo soTitshala bethu ukuze ubrowse othisha abaqinisekisiweyo kwihlabathi. Hlalutya ngendawo, umphakathi, kunye nezinga leminyaka. Funda iivoti ezivela kwabanye abafundi kwaye ubhuke iilekese zodwa ngqo kwi-platifomu.

q6.question: Yintoni eyenza iMundo Tango ihluke?
q6.answer: Sakhiwe ngabadlali be-tango, kubadlali be-tango. Umgomo wethu kukwakha umphakathi wokwenene, ukucwangcisa imicimbi yequality, kunye nokuxhuma nawe nomndeni we-tango wehlabathi - hayi nje enye inethiwekhi yoluntu.
